groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: Silk thread on the left. In his traditional cards it is 糸; here it is 纟.

chars.story: A silk thread you knot yourself to count the years: an era.
chars.note: Also 'age' (年纪) and 'discipline'. Traditional 紀.

chars.story: A silk cord tied round a bird's leg to keep hold of it: preserve.
chars.note: Also 'dimension', and in foreign names: 维也纳 Vienna.

chars.story: The thread running out with the winter: the end.
chars.note: His Analects card in 終: 糸 became 纟.

chars.parts: 纟 silk + 𠃊米 threads in a frame
chars.story: Broken threads in the frame knotted back together: it goes on.
chars.note: Also 'succeed, inherit'. Traditional 繼.

chars.parts: 纟 silk + 色 a knife over a kneeling man
chars.story: A knife cutting the silk clean through: finished, absolutely.
chars.note: Also 'cut off, die out': 灭绝 'become extinct'.

groups.title: person 亻 人
groups.note: 亻 on the left, or 人 on top.

chars.story: A person looked at straight in the eye: what he is worth.
chars.note: Also 'be on duty': 值班.

chars.story: A person with just one hand: merely that.
chars.note: Traditional 僅: 堇 became 又.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 列 line up (sound)
chars.story: One person stepping out of the line to show the rest: an example.
A person's part when things are divided: a portion.
chars.note: A counter for papers and portions: 一份报纸 'a newspaper'.

chars.story: A person who stands out especially: excellent.
chars.note: Traditional 優: 憂 became 尤.

chars.story: A person up on tiptoe, looking ahead: an enterprise.
chars.note: Almost always in 企业 'company'.

groups.title: walking 走 辶 彳
groups.note: Three walking shapes: 走 a striding man, 辶 a road along the foot, 彳 a step on the left.

chars.parts: 走 go on foot + 戉 axe (sound)
chars.story: Striding on past the axe-men at the border: surpass.
chars.note: 越…越 'the more… the more': 越快越好. Also Vietnam: 越南.

chars.parts: 走 go on foot + 召 summon (sound)
chars.story: Running when summoned, past everyone ahead: exceed.
A long road, walked from the very first step: far.
chars.note: His Analects card in 遠: 袁 became 元.

chars.story: A courier with his bundle hurrying down the road: velocity.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 辶 walk + 有 have
chars.story: Walking along behind whoever has the way over the mound: follow along.
chars.note: Traditional 隨.

chars.story: A step taken toward the master: go toward.
chars.note: Also 'past': 以往. 往往 'often' is very common.

groups.title: roof 宀
groups.note: 宀 is a roof: houses and what goes on under them.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 丯 blade + 口 mouth
chars.story: Under one roof, a mouth spitting out cutting words: harm.
chars.note: 害怕 'be afraid' is the commonest word.

chars.story: Each one who comes in under your roof: a visitor.
Under the temple roof, the sacrifice checked over carefully: inspect.
From under the palace roof, word spanning the land: declare.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: 木 on the left or at the foot.

chars.story: A wooden frame for others to copy: a model.
chars.note: Also 'vague' in 模糊.

chars.story: The roof-beam you reach up to: the very top, extremely.
chars.note: Also 'pole': 北极 'North Pole'. Traditional 極.

chars.story: Two trees side by side: woods.
chars.note: Also a common surname. With three trees, 森 is 'forest'.

chars.story: A hand reaching down onto a tree: pick.
chars.note: Traditional 採 also had 扌.

groups.title: tap 攵
groups.note: 攵 is a hand with a stick: tapping, striking, making things happen.

chars.story: Tapping until the pieces cross into place: it takes effect.
Tapping at an old matter until its cause comes out: therefore.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'old (also: therefore)'. In words it is 'event, cause': 故事 'story', 故意 'on purpose'.

chars.story: A tap that makes something arrive: one thing leads to another.
chars.note: Also 'send to': 致辞 'make a speech'.

chars.story: Words that command respect, called out in warning: the police.
chars.note: Also 'warn, alert'.

groups.title: sun 日
groups.note: 日 on top or at the foot: the sun, and time.

chars.story: A tiny sun being born in the night sky: a star.
chars.note: 星期 'week' is very common.

chars.story: The sun just over the stalks: early.
chars.note: 早 alone is 'good morning'.

chars.story: The sun lighting up the work: everything stands out, prominent.
chars.note: Traditional 顯 had 頁 head on the right.

chars.parts: 八 steam + 田 rack + 日 pot
chars.story: Steam rising through the racks: this has been cooked once already.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'Zeng (a surname)', as in Master Zeng. Modern prose: 'once, ever' before a verb.

groups.title: testing
groups.note: Trying, examining, judging.

chars.story: Words set in a fixed form to see if they work: try.
chars.note: Traditional 試.

chars.parts: 耂 old man + 丂 bent stick
chars.story: An old man with a stick, quizzing the young: an exam.
chars.note: Also 'consider': 考虑, 思考.

chars.story: Level words weighing both sides: comment.
chars.note: Traditional 評.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left.

chars.story: A hand drawing the cord tight round everything: comprise.
A hand holding the bowstring back over empty air: take control.
chars.note: Also 'accuse': 指控.

chars.story: A hand closing round something: hold it in your hand.

groups.title: spear 戈
groups.note: 戈 is a dagger-axe: fighting, and shapes that carry one.

chars.story: A hand with a spear, poking through the bushes: look for.
chars.note: Lookalike 我 'I' has an extra stroke on the left.

chars.story: A hand waving a spear on the stage: drama.
chars.note: Traditional 戲.

chars.story: A foot marching behind a spear: martial.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: 口 on the left or on top.

chars.story: A mouth begging for food: eat.
chars.note: Also 'suffer': 吃亏 'lose out'.

chars.story: A mouth turning the question back on you: and what about you?
chars.note: At a sentence's end: 你呢 'and you?'; also 'still going on': 他在吃饭呢.

chars.story: A kneecap over a foot: a whole leg, sufficient to stand on.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'enough'. Also 'foot': 足球 'football'.

groups.title: king 王
groups.note: 王 alone is a king; on the left it is jade, 玉.

chars.story: Heaven, man and earth joined by one stroke: a king.
chars.note: Also one of the commonest surnames.

chars.story: A jade disc with a hole through it: a ring.
chars.note: Above all in 环境 'environment'. Traditional 環.

chars.story: Turning a jade piece over in the hand for fun: play.

groups.title: fire 火 灬
groups.note: 火 is fire; at the foot it becomes four dots, 灬.

chars.story: Flames leaping up on both sides: fire.
chars.note: Also 'anger': 发火 'lose your temper'.

chars.story: Holding something over the fire: hot.
chars.note: Traditional 熱.

chars.story: Soot from the fire coating the chimney flue: black.
chars.note: His Analects card.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left.

chars.story: Water you reach down into and never touch the bottom: deep.
Water that does the work of a whole country: a great river.
chars.note: 江 is a big river, above all the Yangtze; 河 is any river.

chars.story: Water right up to the brim: full.
chars.note: Traditional 滿.

groups.title: rice 米
groups.note: 米 is grains of rice scattered round a stalk.

chars.story: Grains scattered round a stalk: rice.
chars.note: Also 'metre': 一百米 'a hundred metres'.

chars.story: Rice polished down to its fresh heart: the essence.
chars.note: Also 'skilled, refined'.

chars.story: An axe through a bundle of threads: break it off.
chars.note: Traditional 斷.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants and growing things.

chars.story: Grass that changes into colour: a flower.
chars.note: Also 'spend': 花钱 'spend money', 花时间 'spend time'.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 乙 bent stroke
chars.story: A bent figure tending young plants: skill, art.
chars.note: Traditional 藝.

chars.parts: 艹 two fires + 冖 cover + 吕 linked rooms
chars.story: Campfires over a row of linked tents: a camp, run and operated.
chars.note: First sense 'camp': 军营 'barracks'. Traditional 營 had 火火 on top.

groups.title: door 户 and square 方
groups.note: 户 is a one-leaf door; 方 is a square, or a flag on a pole.

chars.story: A single door: one household.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'door' (戶).

chars.story: A door opening onto a square space: a room.

chars.parts: 方 flag + 𠂉 + 矢 arrow
chars.story: Arrows gathered under one flag: a clan, an ethnic group.
chars.note: Also a social group: 上班族 'office workers'.

chars.story: A flag waved to send the orders out: apply them.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'impose'.

groups.title: names abroad
groups.note: Mostly in foreign and place names: 罗马 Rome, 荷兰 Holland, 阿拉伯 Arabia.

chars.story: A net as fine as evening mist: gauze.
chars.note: Mostly in foreign names; also a surname. Traditional 羅.

chars.parts: 丷 two leaves + 三 three blades
chars.story: Two leaves above three blades of leaf: an orchid.
chars.note: Mostly in place names. Traditional 蘭.

chars.story: A friend called to from across the mound: the friendly 'Ah-'.
chars.note: Before names and kin words: 阿姨 'auntie'. Also starts foreign names.

groups.title: alone and together
groups.note: One alone, a flock, working together.

chars.story: An animal with only an insect for company: alone.
chars.note: Traditional 獨.

chars.story: Sheep following their lord: a flock.
Ten people handling the work together: cooperate.
chars.note: Traditional 協 had three 力 on the right.

groups.title: keeping records
groups.note: Writing things down, keeping them, hearing the news.

chars.parts: - a carving knife with chips falling
chars.story: Chips falling as the knife carves: words copied down into wood.
chars.note: Traditional 錄 had 金 metal on the left.

chars.story: A child like a new sprout, kept alive: it exists.
chars.note: Also 'deposit, store': 存钱 'save money'.

chars.story: An ear pressed to the gate: hear.
chars.note: His Analects card in 聞: 門 became 门. Modern 新闻 is 'news'; in speech 闻 is 'smell'.

groups.title: faults and limits
groups.note: Being wrong, being ill, being held back, being severe.

chars.story: Metal ground down the wrong way: a mistake.
chars.note: 不错 'not bad, pretty good' is very common.

chars.story: Someone laid out on the sickbed: a disease.
A mound that stubbornly blocks the way: the limit.

chars.parts: - 业 under a cliff 厂
chars.story: Hard work under an overhanging cliff: severe.
chars.note: Traditional 嚴 had two mouths on top.

groups.title: state and stage
groups.note: How things stand, where they are heading, which part they have reached.

chars.story: The heart leaning too far this way or that: an attitude.
chars.note: Traditional 態: 能 became 太.

chars.story: Strength held in, ready to move: momentum.
chars.note: Traditional 勢.

chars.story: A club breaking stone off a rock face, piece by piece: sections.
chars.note: Counter for stretches: 一段时间 'a while'.

groups.title: head 页 and shell 贝
groups.note: 页 is 贝 with a stroke on top: tell them apart.

chars.story: Hair hanging down from the head: the beard every man has to grow.
chars.note: Also 'beard'. Traditional 須, and 鬚 for beard.

chars.story: Giving your head to it before it comes: in advance.
chars.note: Traditional 預.

chars.story: A thorn pricking you until the debt in shells is paid: responsibility.
chars.note: Also 'blame': 指责.

chars.story: A hook over a head, hauling the goods home: buy.
chars.note: Traditional 買 was a net over 貝 shells. Lookalike 卖 'sell' has 十 on top.

groups.title: knife 刀 and strength 力
groups.note: 刀 and 刂 are a knife; 力 is a ploughing arm.

chars.story: A knife cutting the bones apart and laying them in a row: line up.
Seven strokes of the knife: cut.
chars.note: 一切 'everything' is the commonest word.

chars.story: Work done with strength: an achievement.
A mouth set apart over a bent arm: another one, separate.

groups.title: evening 夕
groups.note: 夕 is a crescent moon: evening.

chars.story: A mountain of evenings, a year at a time: years old.
chars.note: Counter for age: 五岁 'five years old'. Traditional 歲.

chars.story: Many sentences: that's enough.
chars.note: The everyday word: 够了 'that's enough'.

groups.title: horse 马
groups.note: 马 on the right, often there for its sound.

chars.story: The woman who carries you about like a horse: mom.
chars.note: Traditional 媽.

chars.story: All the horses put through their paces: a test.
chars.note: Traditional 驗.

groups.title: again and practise
groups.note: Going over it a second time.

chars.story: A foot going back over the same path: repeat.
chars.note: It stands for 復 'return', 複 'double, complex' and 覆 'reply'.

chars.story: A young bird beating one wing over and over: practise.
chars.note: His Analects card in 習: two wings over 白 became one wing.

groups.title: shapes learned whole
groups.note: Shapes with no handy parts.

chars.story: One stroke over white: a hundred.
An animal hide stretched and scraped: changed, reformed.
chars.note: The first sense is 'leather'.

chars.story: Many hands lifting together: excitement.
chars.note: Also 'rise, flourish': 兴起. Traditional 興.

chars.parts: - a head hung upside down on a cord
chars.story: A head hung upside down by a cord at the gate: the county seat.
chars.note: Traditional 縣.

chars.parts: - a shoot coming up through the ground
chars.story: A shoot pushing up through the ground: earth.
chars.note: His Analects card. Also 'local, rustic'.

chars.story: A bow with its string pulled back: draw out.

sentences.en: A picture is worth a thousand words.
The police are investigating the cause of the accident.

sentences.zh: 他考试拿了满分是真的。
sentences.en: It is true that he got full marks on the test.

sentences.zh: 学习物理能够改变思维。
sentences.en: Learning physics can change your way of thinking.

sentences.zh: 人类不能在火星上生存。
他买土地目的是要造房子。
sentences.en: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.

sentences.zh: 因为体育场离我家不远，我往往去看足球赛。
sentences.en: Because the stadium is not far from my house, I often go to football games.
